data.title: Unit 7: Force, work and energy
How simple tools work
data.text: Click on either Right or Wrong for the following sentences.
Force is a push or a pull.
The harder the force, the slower is the speed of the object.
Gravity is a force which pulls two objects towards each other.
When force is applied on an object and the object moves, we say work has been done.
When a match is struck, the chemical energy stored in it produces heat and light.

feedback.rank1: Hmm... You can do better than this.
